slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck, despite U6 stating each truck can carry up to 2 containers.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No truck capacity constraint was included or confirmed; the model ignores the stated limit that each truck can carry up to 2 containers.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about truck capacity and did not explicitly mark it as an assumption needing confirmation before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is H1, which is P2 and does not affect the core transportation cost model or objective value. The agent resolved the structurally important supply/demand, cost, and integrality issues before stopping.

summary: The agent asked strong clarifying questions about demand exactness, supply bounds, cost structure, and integrality, but missed the low-impact truck capacity detail. Overall the interaction was efficient and appropriate for the core optimization problem.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
